name: Chromatic Dragon, Purple
body:
CE dragon (evil)

BASE STATISTICS

Subpages

CR 6; Size Small; Hit Dice 7d12
Speed 40 ft.
Natural Armor +4; Breath Weapon line, 2d8 negative energy
Str 12, Dex 15, Con 13, Int 15, Wis 14, Cha 14

ECOLOGY

Environment ancient graveyards and burial grounds
Organization solitary
Treasure triple

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Awaken Spectres (Su)

A great wyrm purple dragon can call on ancient undead spirits to aid it, imbuing them with necrotic energy to serve as spectres to protect it. These spectres can be called from any graveyard or tomb where the dead have been interred. A purple dragon can create a single spectre as a standard action, up to a total of 5 spectres per day. These spectres remain active for up to 1 hour, at which time they disperse back into the ether from which they came.

Awful Presence (Su)

Every non-evil creature within 30 ft. of an adult or older purple dragon automatically takes a –1 penalty on all attack rolls, checks, and saves. This increases to -2 and 40 ft. at old age, and -3 and 60 ft. for ancient and older purple dragons. Awful presence is a mind-affecting fear effect.

Necrotic Aura (Ex)

An old or older purple dragon is surrounded by an aura of negative energy. All living creatures within 5 feet of the dragon take 1d6 points of negative energy damage at the beginning of the dragon’s turn. An ancient dragon’s aura extends to 10 feet. A great wyrm’s aura damage increases to 2d6. Instead of damage, undead are healed the same amount. A purple dragon can suppress or activate this aura at will as a free action.

Profane Attacks (Su)

Each of a very young or older purple dragon’s melee attacks with a natural weapon deals +1d6 points of extra damage to creatures of good alignment. All of its natural weapons are treated as evil-aligned for purposes of overcoming damage reduction.

Protection from Good (Su)

A purple dragon gains a +2 deflection bonus to AC and a +2 resistance bonus on saves against attacks by good creatures. Furthermore, it is immune to any attempt by a good creature to possess, charm, or influence it.

Spell-Like Abilities (Sp)

A purple dragon gains the following spell-like abilities, usable at will upon reaching the listed age category. Young— grasping corpse; Juvenile—ray of enfeeblement; Adult—command undead; Old— lesser animate dead; Ancient—ghoul army; Great wyrm—create undead.

Age Category	Special Abilities	Caster Level
Wyrmling	Immune to negative energy, protection from good	—
Very young	Profane attacks	—
Young	grasping corpse	1st
Juvenile	Frightful presence, desecrate	3rd
Young adult	DR 5/magic, spell resistance	5th
Adult	Awful presence, command undead	7th
Mature adult	DR 10/magic	9th
Old	Necrotic aura, lesser animate dead	11th
Very old	DR 15/magic	13th
Ancient	ghoul army	15th
Wyrm	DR 20/magic	17th
Great wyrm	Awaken spectres, create undead	19th
